description: Georgia's national electricity grid right now: hydro, thermal, wind and solar generation, total generation, cross-border flow on the Azerbaijan, Armenia, Russia (Salkhino/Java/Nakaduli lines) and Turkey tie lines, and total consumption — in MW as a 3-minute moving average. Sourced from the JSC Georgian State Electrosystem real-time system export, published every 3 minutes. Every value carries its QUALITY flag: ACT means actual telemetry, SUB means the operator substituted a figure and NRE means telemetry was not received, so SUB and NRE values are NOT measurements and must not be reported as such.

max_lookback_slots.description: How many 3-minute slots to walk back looking for the most recent published export. Publication lags a few minutes, so the current minute usually does not exist yet. Default 10 (30 minutes).

name: gse_grid_now
title: Gse Grid Now
